statement: All principal views shall use one unified global navigation workspace header and persistent status region.
acceptance_method: Navigate all eight views without losing product identity or state labels.

statement: Draft published imported reviewed unresolved simulated and real-lab states shall use text icon and accessible label not color alone.
acceptance_method: Inspect rendered states and accessible names.

statement: Every interactive control shall be reachable and operable by keyboard in logical order.
acceptance_method: Keyboard-only walkthrough of principal flows.

statement: Visible focus shall meet contrast and not be clipped or obscured.
acceptance_method: Focus-state screenshot and manual contrast review.

statement: Arabic paragraphs and navigation labels shall use native RTL and right alignment.
acceptance_method: DOM dir inspection and RTL screenshot review.

statement: English identifiers paths APIs commands code logs and packet fields shall be isolated LTR without reversing strings.
acceptance_method: Copy comparison DOM dir inspection and mixed-text screenshot.

statement: Desktop tablet and mobile layouts shall reflow without horizontal page clipping and shall preserve primary actions.
acceptance_method: Viewport tests at 1440x1000 1024x768 and 390x844.

statement: Dashboard shall explain current queue priorities open reviews evidence gaps and recent audited work.
acceptance_method: Content and responsive navigation review.

statement: Source review shall expose library context segment content and provenance authority inspector in coordinated panes.
acceptance_method: Three-pane desktop and stacked mobile walkthrough.

statement: Knowledge Studio shall support study inline structured review source comparison and revision comparison without losing lesson context.
acceptance_method: Mode-switch and retained-context tests.

statement: Block editing shall demonstrate insertion reordering nesting validation and draft versus published comparison.
acceptance_method: Interactive prototype and later component tests.

statement: Curriculum workspace shall show Domain Cluster Capability KU hierarchy prerequisites evidence needs and coverage limitations.
acceptance_method: Hierarchy navigation and limitation-label review.

statement: Guided Lab shall show scenario context simulated role device inputs deterministic trace evidence origin hints reset and replay.
acceptance_method: VS-001 desktop mobile and interaction walkthrough.

statement: Enterprise Designer and Scenario Studio shall present reusable catalogs graph timeline validation and baseline-run separation.
acceptance_method: Graph timeline and baseline warning walkthrough.

statement: Evidence and Mastery shall show evidence origin criteria decision mastery rule revision failures and scheduled review.
acceptance_method: State transition and failure-review walkthrough.

statement: Manual AI Bridge shall show selected export scope manifest statuses validation failures proposed diff and human decisions.
acceptance_method: Full manual status walkthrough with invalid import state.

statement: Toggle and collapsible lesson blocks shall be native editable controls with correct expanded state.
acceptance_method: Keyboard toggle aria-expanded and nested-content tests.

statement: Every technical claim and generated result shall expose provenance or a truthful unresolved limitation.
acceptance_method: Inspect claim result and evidence detail views.

statement: Destructive actions shall be visible explicit confirmable and reversible where the lifecycle permits.
acceptance_method: Destructive-action inventory and confirmation tests.

statement: Simulated output shall never use an unqualified real or production label.
acceptance_method: Text scan and evidence-label visual review.

statement: Semantic landmarks headings labels tables status messages and error associations shall support assistive technology.
acceptance_method: Automated accessibility tree and manual screen-reader spot checks.

statement: Code command log and output blocks shall remain copyable in logical LTR order.
acceptance_method: Copy-paste equality test for mixed Arabic and technical content.
